# Renewal on runs and the relational reading of living

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Renewal and consumption classify runs: each run of any process, read through observables of conditions, is a web to which the classes apply; a natural-number observable never rising from some step on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps; from one configuration one run can renew, another consume.

`becoming-renewal-reading` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07

Editable record: [becoming-renewal-reading.json](becoming-renewal-reading.json) · [Register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

Documentary review UTC: `2026-10-13T09:54:07+00:00`. Run the registry checker for source drift; this page is not a fresh proof receipt.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Every run of every process, read through observables of conditions, is one relational unfolding to which the renewing/consuming classification applies. A natural-number observable that never rises from some step on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps; depletion, recurrent renewal under a natural rank and unrenewed drawdown are its cases. The class belongs to the run: in one process from one configuration, with the focal formation active at every step, one run renews and another consumes.

Canonical source: [Renewal.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Renewal.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Levels of conditions, activity, dependence (with its level) and drawing are observables of configurations; dependence and drawing do not vary with the configuration.
- `living` is the whole-run relational reading (active and not consuming), a disclosed reading choice, not a proved correspondence; relation through a common condition is significance-through-a-common-condition's.

Formations and conditions are analytic roles in one unfolding, not independent entities or owners of value. What counts as a condition and as participation decides connection, which significance-through-a-common-condition states with its caveat on idle conditions; a too coarse common condition empties living (independent review Q10), which condition-correspondence-discipline does not resolve. The reading is relative to a run. The correspondence of observables to an actual history, whether a common condition (such as the biosphere or climate) is in fact participated in by every living formation, and whether the relational reading is the right reading of 生生 are application or philosophical duties.

The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). This record binds Bridge to the new frozen receipt while other proofs retain their original receipts; adapters are not independent results.

Proves none of self-significance, both neutralities, A, C, L or J1–J4; binds none rejecting them. The unification of bounds is organizational, not new mathematics; ContinuationRenewal's well-founded form is not derived from the principle. The relational reading is a disclosed reading choice; whether it is the right reading of 生生 lies outside this result. The correspondence discipline for conditions is stated for the stepwise reading only (condition-correspondence-discipline); the reading is relative to a run and includes no component of further generation. A formation's class (RenewingIn, ConsumingIn) depends on identity across steps, while a condition's class does not (identity-across-steps).

- The renewable model has no feedback: the loss in the run beyond renewal persists only because drawing keeps exceeding renewal; irreversible loss needs the feedback of the RelationalRenewal law family. [Renewal.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Renewal.lean)
- Dependence is static and the reading is whole-run rather than stepwise; both are inherited from existing modules. This result holds at that scope; becoming-dependence-dynamics and becoming-stepwise-reading relax both (integration note §6). **Output:** The renewing/consuming classification on arbitrary unfoldings and the finite bound on unrenewed drawdown.

**Input:** The unfolding read from a run through observables.

**Preserved conditions:** Static dependence and drawing; natural-number levels. [Renewal.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Renewal.lean)


**Output:** The relational reading: active events of non-consuming formations are generative grounds.

**Input:** `living` of Conditions.valuation.

**Preserved conditions:** The family of continuations is one run. [Metaethics.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Metaethics.lean)


**Output:** On a connected whole, living significance ⇔ seed ∧ relational neutrality ∧ standpoint neutrality; relational neutrality's transmission rule.

**Input:** The Valuation given by a run's relational reading, with its connection.

**Preserved conditions:** Standpoints, regions and significance remain supplied; some living event is needed. [Metaethics.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Metaethics.lean)

- Related, not a proved adapter: [open-form-realization-under-revision](open-form-realization-under-revision.md). ContinuationRenewal's natural-rank recurrence bound is a case of falls_not_recurring (Run.renewal_recurs); its well-founded form is more general and is not derived here.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [renewing-consuming-formation](renewing-consuming-formation.md). That result's narrower law class and living-significance interface are independent of this reading; no conversion between them is established.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [becoming-spine-instances](becoming-spine-instances.md). The two modules the classification left to P3b are placed by this result as renewal bounds on runs.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [condition-correspondence-discipline](condition-correspondence-discipline.md). That result states a correspondence discipline for conditions: only interaction relates through a condition; idle conditions no longer connect for free, and connection holds for a declared class.
